units.source_text: 玩了约莫一个小时，艺人们到这旅馆的室内浴池洗澡去了。

en.t: After playing for about an hour, the entertainers went to bathe in the indoor bath at this inn.

units.source_text: 她们再三邀我同去，因为有三个年轻女子，

en.t: They invited me again and again to go with them, but since there were three young women,

units.source_text: 所以我搪塞了一番，说我过一会儿再去。

en.t: I made an excuse and said I would go a little later.

units.source_text: 舞女马上一个人上楼来，转达千代子的话说：

en.t: The dancing girl immediately came upstairs alone and relayed Chiyoko's words:
